description:
Lithium-ion cells: voltage, temperature and thermal runaway, computed again with a proof on every row
	

Battery programs qualify a cell model on two questions: does its voltage follow the measured cell through the discharges and drive cycles it will see, from -20 to 40 degC, and when does an abused cell run away. Here are 252 runs of three models of real cells, each computed again with a cryptographic proof on every row, beside the laboratory's measurements: every published… See the full description on the dataset page: https://huggingface.co/datasets/zero-trust-physics/zero-trust-physics-li-ion-cells.
